card.name: Start of a word after a qualifier
card.fires_on: The first piece of a medical word that follows a linking or qualifying phrase, such as 'with', 'independent', 'including' or 'to', in drug-label text. Examples are 'renal', 'sexual', and the first letter of drug names like lurasidone and lacosamide.

modes.label: Condition word after 'with'
modes.description: Words like renal or sexual that name a patient condition or category right after a qualifier.
modes.example: dosing in pediatric patients with<< renal>> impairment.

modes.label: Start of a drug name
modes.description: The first letter of lurasidone or lacosamide when the drug is named in running text.
modes.example: organ hypersensitivity, has been reported in patients taking antiepileptic drugs, including<< l>>acosamide.

modes.label: Inside split medical terms
modes.description: The opening piece of a word split into parts, such as the 're' in B-cell repletion or 'ia' in hyperkalemia.
modes.example: until B-cell<< re>>pletion, administer all immunizations
